units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 23:42">Targ. Y. Lev. XXIII, 42</cite>.—Y. Kil. IX, 32ᶜ bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 12:3:14">Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵇ</cite> <he>יהבון בח׳</he> put them into a cavern.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28b:1">Ab. Zar. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ דבי צוארא</he> neck-hole of a garment. Y. ib. II, 40ᵈ top <he>עביר עינא כחללה</he> (not <he>כחל לה</he>) considers the eye like an inner organ (for treatment on the Sabbath, v. <cite ref="H01078">preced.</cite>).

senses.gloss: pl. חֲלָלֵי, in ח׳ דעלמא the underground treasures of the world.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 97a">Snh. 97ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 49a:16">B. Mets. 49ᵃ</cite> (<cite ref="H01079"><he>חללא</he></cite>, corr. acc., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 6).
<cite ref="Shabbat 77b">Sabb. 77ᵇ</cite> if they asked him <he>כל ח׳ עלמא</he> about all the secret processes of nature.
